services.name: Single kayak
services.desc: Join us as we take a relaxing kayak journey through the Weedon Island Preserve! Our tour will begin by taking you into the pristine blue waters and seagrass meadows of the Weedon Island Preserve as we search for manatees and dolphins. After hanging out with our underwater friends, we will then make our way to the winding mangrove tunnels. These mesmerizing tunnels stretch for miles and are some of the longest tunnels in all of Florida. While paddling through these tunnels, be on the lookout for mangrove crabs, mullet, and countless varieties of birds that nest inside the mangrove forests. All along the way our experienced tour guides will be answering all of your questions and will educate
